Why... why this............
If only you were stronger—give me a break. Seriously.
I'm saying, I dunno why, but I just got sick of it!

Uhh, "Find the natural number such that its square root is a natural number"...?
What even is a natural number? Oh, like numbers found in nature? What does that mean? A forest?

*sigh* ...Weak, annoying, and doing this in our room makes Ticket-san
start bawling, which is even more annoying. Seriously, what is your deal, you stupid hooves?

Despite her weary tone, Tosen Jordan's hands moved with meticulous care,
tirelessly looking after her hooves and nails.

...Urrrgh~~~! What is this nonsense? Total gibberish.
I'm never gonna finish this~~~.
...I don't know. No clue.
Whenever you feel like talking about racing, you're always welcome to come by.

Tosen Jordan slumped face-first onto her desk with force.
In the process... the worksheet tore cleanly down the middle.

I'm telling you, you'd better go right now! She sounded pretty ticked off.
Skipping is fine and all, but if you don't play it smart, you're gonna end up expelled for real!
(*grumble~*)

Tosen Jordan hadn't torn it on purpose.
I thought she would properly explain herself, but—

...Anyway, what's it to you? Don't you have better things to care about?
Just leave a loser like me alone already!
...I missed breakfast, okay?!

...What happened? Even when injured, you worked so hard.
If something is troubling you, I'd like to hear it, if you're willing to share.

While genuinely apologizing for having eavesdropped...
this was an opportunity, and I didn't want to back down now.

And that was precisely why I couldn't understand
why Tosen Jordan was avoiding races in the first place.

............Understood. For today, just finish this assignment before you head back.
I prepared it summarizing the key points from this week's lessons.

Tosen Jordan pointed toward
a flashy fast-food joint serving up junk food.
But hey, if that's what everybody says, guess that's how it is.

A few days after bad rumors about Tosen Jordan began circulating.
As I passed by the school gates—
Huh? Well, I mean, I guess I did tear it... technically.

...Answer me seriously. I'm worried about you.
Have you lost your motivation?

Tell me, have you really lost your drive?
Do you really not want to run in races anymore? ...Really?

Without clearing up the misunderstanding, Tosen Jordan turned away as if having resigned herself.
Unable to leave her be, I went after her.

Because I was caring for them?
Nah... that's not it, taking care of them just keeps me grounded, kinda.

Talk? Ahh... lemme guess, did the academy tell you something?
Like, get in the races, go to training properly, or whatever?
Like I said, I don't get it either. Even I don't know.

............I see.
...Understood. I understand loud and clear that you have no motivation.
Ohh. She just called me directly. That's why I just got back right now.

How's it going? ...Wait, huh? What happened to the worksheet?
...Did you rip it?
H-Hah? Like I'd ever fall for bait like that! Don't mess with me!

You're always pushing everyone away—why won't you face things
properly? If you keep acting like this, no one can help you.

Still...! Handling things like this isn't right, you know?
Ripping it on purpose is going way too far!
Huh?! Wait, when?
Not really, everything just feels like a drag, y'know? I dunno.
...Whatever...
Mmm... I know.

Sorry 'bout that, looks like I'm just totally out of motivation.
So sucks for you, but just give up already.

I mean, whether I wanna run or don't wanna run...
I don't even know myself.
Ah! There's Jordan! The teacher's looking for you!

...Hmm. Then how about that place?
Let me eat as much as I want there.
Huh? What does an academy Trainer want with me?

Following after her, I found Toosen Jordan meticulously applying coating
to her cracked hooves. Various hoof care products lay scattered around her.

......*sigh*.
It's over. It's totally over. There's no way. I can't do this anymore.

Judging by how thoroughly she cared for her hooves,
it didn't seem like she truly wanted to give up on racing.

Skipping class, blowing off tests—if that were all, it'd be one thing,
but she refused to race, and didn't even show up to training at all.

So, after waiting a few days for the right chance—
I spotted Toosen Jordan slacking off in town.

A few hours after seeing her at the school gates—
I spotted her in an empty classroom, wrestling with a worksheet.
